description: Retrieve TBA-generated match score predictions and end-of-event ranking predictions for an event when computed. Returns predicted red/blue scores keyed by match key plus predicted final ranks keyed by team key. Availability and field structure vary by event and game year; some events return null or partial data.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_predictions
